summary: Round-3 (Twogether gallery + screenshot-protection). Backend: 48/48 pytest PASS — 12 new round-3 tests validate (a) GET /api/gallery returns ONLY messages with media_id, newest-first, gated (400 'Not paired' for solo, 401 unauth); (b) kind='system' messages are accepted, stored ciphertext-only, appear in /api/messages but are EXCLUDED from /api/gallery (asserted from BOTH partners); (c) media byte-exact upload/download round-trip; (d) view-once media returns 410 after recipient marks viewed; (e) messages/worries/events/checkins/pair/auth regression all pass. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): chat header now shows images/voice/video buttons; gallery route navigates via chat-gallery; Shared Gallery screen renders with 3-col tile grid; view-once tile is a locked 'View once' card (not openable); tapping a normal tile opens fullscreen viewer with Save button when allow_save=true; tapping Save on web produces graceful toast 'Saving works on the mobile app' (no crash); system messages render as centered warning pill in chat feed (not a normal bubble); Worries screen still renders + FAB works inside PrivacyGuard. FIXED one critical web crash: `expo-screen-capture` has no `addScreenshotListener` on web (RN Web red-screen 'ExpoScreenCapture.default.addListener is not a function' that blocked both Gallery + Worries). Added Platform.OS==='web' no-op guard in src/lib/screenshot.ts — screenshot BLOCKING (Android) / DETECTION (iOS) remain device-only as specified. Post-fix: zero console errors, all screens load.

rca_of_issue: Bug fixed: expo-screen-capture's addScreenshotListener throws on Web because ExpoScreenCapture (default) has no `.addListener`. PrivacyGuard mounted it via useScreenshotGuard, causing a red-screen error and preventing Gallery + Worries from rendering on the Expo web preview. Reproduction: log in on web → tap gallery icon → red screen 'ExpoScreenCapture.default.addListener is not a function'. Mitigation applied: early-return on Platform.OS==='web' + optional-chaining on all ScreenCapture calls. Device (iOS/Android) code paths untouched — screenshot blocking on Android and detection on iOS remain fully wired to send an encrypted kind='system' message to the partner.
